title: Client Config Generator
description: Generate a centralized client configuration file with ApiClient setup and utility exports

projectName.description: The project where the config will be generated

clientPackage.description: Client package to import from (e.g., @myfeature/client). Defaults to @next-feature/client

baseUrl.description: Base URL for API requests (e.g., process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)
